notes: Adds a Reviews settings page (Reviews > Settings) with an on/off switch for the whole public side of the feature - when off, GET /api/reviews returns an empty list and submissions are rejected, without affecting panel management. Also adds the public submission endpoint: POST /api/reviews (author_name, rating, body, optional related_service) - language and country are never taken from the caller, only auto-detected server-side from the submitter's IP (free geolocation lookup, best-effort - falls back to the site's default language if detection fails or the country isn't recognized). Submitted reviews land unapproved and stay invisible until approved in the Reviews section. Limited to one submission per IP every 2 hours, on top of the existing CORS-origin-allowlist/abuse protections shared with the other public write endpoints. No database changes.
